integrity: The recent source's arXiv record verifies first public date 2026-09-28 and primary MSC 03E55. Its full text was checked at Theorem 1.1, Proposition 2.7, and the PID specialization. The Shelah--Struengmann full paper was checked at Main Theorem 4.1 and the explicit continuous free filtration used in Theorem 4.2. The lower-bound conversion to a nonprojective Z-module is proved directly from indecomposability.
scientific_limitations: The exact threshold is conditional on V=L and the existence of a weakly compact cardinal, and is asserted only among regular uncountable cardinals. The property is deliberately restricted to rings of cardinality below the tested cardinal. No ZFC characterization of weak compactness is claimed.
title: In L, universal almost-projective compactness begins at the first weakly compact cardinal
